Job Opportunity - **Research Program Manager** at Furhat Robotics in Stockholm, Sweden.

Furhat Robotics is looking for a Research Program Manager to lead and grow our academic and research-ecosystem. You'll coordinate funded projects, nurture collaborations, and act as the bridge between our internal teams and external academic partners.

The role sits at the intersection of **human-robot interaction, social robotics, research project management, and academic community building**. It would suit someone with a research background who enjoys working across universities, funded projects, students, and the broader HRI community.

The Research Program Manager will work closely with Furhat's academic collaborators and research users around the world, while coordinating our own participation in research projects and funding initiatives.

**The role includes:**

• Managing EU-funded and other collaborative research projects, including reporting, deliverables, budgets, and consortium coordination

• Developing collaborations with universities and research groups using Furhat

• Identifying funding opportunities and contributing to research proposals

• Coordinating MSc thesis students, research interns, and related academic activities

• Organizing research workshops, events, and activities around conferences such as HRI, RO-MAN, IVA, and Interspeech

• Following research conducted with Furhat and helping connect insights from the research community back to our team

We are particularly interested in candidates with a **PhD or similar research background in HRI, robotics, AI, cognitive science, computer science, or a related field**, together with experience coordinating research projects. Experience with EU-funded projects and grant proposals is particularly relevant.

The position is based in **Stockholm, Sweden**.
